name: exportId
label: Export ID
help: A finished export of that clip, from Export a clip, or from an Export IDs item of a Finishing finished event. Narriflow picks the format that fits the account's platform.

name: socialAccountId
label: Social account
help: The connected account whose Publishing Queue gets the draft.

name: caption
label: Caption
help: Up to 5,000 characters. Leave empty to use the latest copy Narriflow wrote for that platform, if any.

name: runKey
label: Run key
help: Narriflow remembers a request for good, so the same inputs are the same request forever. Map the trigger's Event ID here to run once for each event.
